name: Hadamard between two π/2 X-rotations
summary: A Hadamard gate between two π/2 X-rotations is a −π/2 Z-rotation.
description:
Sandwiching a Hadamard gate between two X-rotations by π/2 (the $V=\sqrt X$ gate) gives the Z-rotation by −π/2 (the $S^\dagger$ gate), up to a global phase: $VHV \propto S^\dagger$.

This is the [Euler decomposition of the Hadamard](../euler-decomposition-hadamard/) in its colour-swapped form $H \propto X(\frac\pi2)Z(\frac\pi2)X(\frac\pi2)$, with the outer X-rotations moved to the other side. It is useful for absorbing Hadamards into neighbouring Clifford phases.
